limitations: This is a block-level spatial study, not a manufacturing shell.
PCB outline and USB edge cutout must be synchronized with E14 after routing.
Battery supplier maximum envelope, leads, protection board and swelling allowance are unknown.
FPC insertion, screen support, button travel, wall thickness and assembly tolerances are not verified.
No vendor Gerber, Excellon, BOM, CPL, printable STEP or STL is generated from this study.
